As his voice begins to change, the boy decides to venture beyond the fence on his own, and in the back alleys of Tokyo comes face to face with realities far removed from what he has known. Yet just as truth has many faces, so too does its opposite, and Kiita gradually comes to see—and accept—that the lie that has protected his world has another face of its own.

title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

title: Mrigaya 1.5: The Hunt Continues
overview: Officer-in-Charge Debanjan Dutta of the Kolkata Police and his team face mounting danger while investigating a gruesome crime that shakes their neighborhood. As twists derail the probe, a ruthless gang spreads chaos across the city. With tensions rising and violence erupting, the hunt intensifies.

title: Ash and Crayons
overview: Seven Ukrainian children demonstrate resilience while facing catastrophic injuries and forcible deportations during the ongoing war, their stories told through verité footage and animation by Ukrainian artists.

title: Armored Trooper VOTOMS: Die Graue Hexe - Part 1
overview: A never-ending battlefield ruled by madness, but there was a witch who would surely rise again.

title: El mal padre
overview: After years of estrangement, the famous writer and academic Santiago Balmes gathers his three children for a last request: to spend Christmas in the house where they used to spend summers as kids.

title: The Tragedy of the Bernalillo County Detectives
overview: 1979. An intense conspiracy unfolds after the robbery of a legendary fortune.

title: Shankarabharana
overview: Shankarabharana is an upcoming Kannada action thriller story written by Shine Shetty and directed by Sumanth Bhat.

title: Phantom 814
overview: Heavy Weekend 03: Unique access to the most mysterious organisation in France. Jake Hanrahan travels with the bizarre syndicate known as "814SSR". They shoot guns, host fight clubs, and make money in the underground. Yet still, they insist they're not a gang and are simply doing hardcore trolling. The truth? Decide for yourself...

title: Jalaaki
overview: Plot to be announced.

title: Beparwah
overview: Starring Dev Kharoud

title: Red Snow
overview: In Finland, sixteen-year-old emo teen Johanna dreams of a glittering Twilight vampire prince. What she gets instead is Martti — a balding, beer-bellied 49-year-old bloodsucker who slips into a Santa suit to gain entry to homes and devour entire families. When Johanna crosses paths with Martti on Christmas Eve, she thinks her dark fairy tale has come true, buy instead of eternal romance, she finds herself trapped in a bloody and horrific nightmare of aging masculine toxicity, family trauma, and festive slaughter.

title: A Bouquet of Light for You
The Day After Sunday
overview: Awaiting prenatal screening results, Mai’s mounting anxiety collides with her husband Koichi’s passive avoidance, escalating hidden spousal tension into unbearable friction.

title: Joyride Returns
overview: Rusty Nail returns 12 years later, to turn the desert road of the Arizona in blood, as a group of friends on vacation go to a small town near the mountains to explore them, as Rusty Nail with his black truck is near.

title: Box of Memories
overview: Days after running away from home, Pablo roams the streets with nothing but a backpack. One night he comes across Regina, who knows the streets by heart, the two end up bonding over photographs, as they both use them as a means of escape.

title: Back on North Face
overview: Why risk everything on a thousand-foot cliff? After legendary Taiwanese climber Shiu Yau Chiun's fatal accident, his Canadian climbing partner Patrick Lindsay and student (the director) lead a cross-border team back to Yushan's East Peak North Face. Battling storms and grief, they establish a new route, “Shiu Be Here,” honoring their friend. Years later, Patrick returns to a remote Canadian summit, whispering, “See you on the next peak.”

title: Harm Reduction
overview: Convinced of his own remarkability, student Piotr Kotara dreams of a life filled with spectacular achievements, praise, and love. When repeated failures challenge his self-image, he turns to drugs - first as a means to success, and eventually as an escape from the disintegration of his identity.

title: Three Generations, One Christmas
overview: Set in a close-knit American town, Christmas at The Starlight centers on The Starlight, a beloved local supper club and longtime community gathering place where generations have come together to celebrate music, family, and Christmas traditions. Frank (Tony Danza)—a legendary song-and-dance man—prepares to sell the family’s beloved restaurant lounge after 40 years. With the future of The Starlight in question, three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey that reminds them what is worth preserving — and how faith, family, and home can quietly lead us back to where we belong.

title: Remember the Summit
overview: Sir Chris Bonington’s return to Torres del Paine, 62 years after the first ascent of the Central Tower.  At 91 years old, and while living with Alzheimer’s disease, the documentary accompanies Bonington in a profoundly human return: an attempt to reconnect with memories that time has erased, but that the Patagonian landscape still seems to guard. During the filming, Chris once again set foot on the territory of Estancia Cerro Guido, closing a circle between past and present, between the epic of mountaineering and the fragility of memory.

title: Letters This Christmas
overview: A young romance author leaves New York City after her novel is panned, hoping to write a redemption novel from home in Alaska. Finding inspiration in her former lover, and the mysterious Christmas cards left at her keys, newfound success has her making the difficult choice between returning to New York for a career of fictional romance, and her real romance in Alaska.

title: Double Booked for the Holidays
overview: The one thing identical twins — quiet and bookish Abigail and globe-trotting event planner Charlie — can agree on is that this first Christmas without their mom will be difficult. When they unexpectedly get a last-minute chance to travel to Wales and spend a week running the Story Shoppe, an AirBnb/bookshop in Hay-on-Wye, they jump at the opportunity. Abigail is particularly excited, given the town’s role as the backdrop of the bestselling Winterton Chronicles, her all-time favorite Regency holiday romances.

title: I'm Right Over Here, Why Can't You See Me?
overview: a sequel to the short film WHERE HAVE YOU GONE, GIRL? by milly worthington.

title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit
overview: Join the Doctor and Rose as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.

title: Axolodyssey
overview: An animated adventure about Jojo the Axolotl, taking on the world to find his family, set in a fantastically inspired Mexican lakeside.

title: Way of the Warrior Kid
overview: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

title: THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
overview: Eight years after the events of Once Upon a Time in... Hollywood, Cliff Booth returns to a changing Los Angeles. Now working as a fixer in the shadows of the Hollywood studio system, Cliff finds himself entangled in a dangerous web of secrets, crimes and betrayals that will test everything he knows about loyalty and survival.

title: Hexed
overview: An impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice, they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

title: Focker-in-Law
overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

title: Lilo & Scratch
overview: Stitch is tasked with looking after Scratch, a cat Lilo has found, but Scratch has more similarities with Stitch than meets the eye.

title: Fantasy
overview: Mihrije, Sina, and Jasna are best friends in their early twenties who live in Slovenia. They are tomboys and refuse to conform to the conservative system they live in. Their world turns upside down when they meet Fantasy, a transgender woman. Together, they embark on a journey that explores the complexities of gender, desire, and self-discovery.

title: Congo Boy
overview: Bangui, Central African Republic. 17 year-old Robert dreams of a career in music, but civil war is tearing the country apart. When both his parents are thrown into prison, he is left to look after his four younger siblings on his own, juggling daily life, odd jobs, school exams and concert stages, determined to follow his dream.

title: Love Lessons
overview: On the eve of retirement, Émile delivers one final lesson about love and literature, urging his students to become the poets of their own lives. But is he still in love himself? Unable to answer, he returns home only to discover that his wife has left him. Émile must now live by the very words he’s been preaching, and thanks to unexpected encounters his life is turned upside down, helping him to reinvent himself.

title: Forty Love
overview: Sacha Gallo, a tennis prodigy, has been training with his father to win a major trophy in Paris. But the arrival of a charismatic new rival challenges everything Sacha thought he understood about competition, ambition, and himself.

title: Hershey
overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company.  Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s orphans.

title: Rewind Barcelona
overview: Hascoët, Émile, Léo, and Paul are a rowdy group of teenage skateboarders. They pile into Léo’s mom’s car and drive to Barcelona, the mecca of skateboarding, for their first trip away as almost-adults. They live on vacuum-sealed tortillas, drink warm cans of Lemon Damm, and spend their days and nights at MACBA. The beach might as well not exist, and the Sagrada Família is just something they pass on the way. All that matters is skating, drifting through the city, and burning through those first fragile days of freedom. Ten years later, they try to piece it back together over a few scattered phone calls. The memories are still there, but something has shifted. What once felt infinite now comes back in fragments.

title: A Good Little Soldier
overview: Follows Carla, a 43-year-old high-performing executive newly recruited as HR manager of a major insurer, tasked with rebuilding its brand in a corporate environment where vulnerability is not an asset.

title: Thanks for Coming
overview: Alain is getting older. For years he has been filming his daily life: his partner Françoise, the people he meets, nature and animals, and life in all its splendour and cruelty. Having devoted his entire life to filmmaking, with the camera as an extension of his arm, he has observed the world with a poetic sense of authenticity and simplicity. Otherness, the approach of death, the power of life and the importance of others intertwine as he looks back on his life as a filmmaker and as a man, concealing nothing, and offering a vision of the universality of the human experience.

title: Orang Sebelah
overview: This film is based on one of the well-known, spine-chilling myths circulating around the IPB University campus area that haunts the students living in the campus dorms.

title: The Fox
overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

title: Pulang Kampung
overview: A Batak musical film that will bring the audience's hearts back to their hometown.

title: Alexander I
overview: Catherine II always knew that her successor would not be her son Pavel, but her beloved grandson Aleksandr. From his earliest years, he was brought up as a future ruler - in strict discipline and with a brilliant education. Having finally become emperor, Aleksandr intended to continue the reforms of his predecessors - to abolish serfdom and introduce a constitution. But at the beginning of the 19th century, a war broke out between two great empires - France and Russia. Aleksandr had to go through a thorny path from brilliant reforms to the Patriotic War.

title: From Inside Out - The Architecture of Peter Zumthor
overview: We all come from houses in which we live, dream, love and die. This long-term documentary project explores the significance of architecture in our everyday lives and takes its audience on a journey to the most impressive places designed by Swiss architect Peter Zumthor.

title: Crazy Christmas
overview: The Serediuk household in Yablunivka sits nigh empty and its proud patriarch Vasyl Serediuk decides that, to end his loneleyness, he'll have to resort to drastic measures, faking a chronic condition and inviting all of his friends and family members over for "one last mutual Christmas". But, his lies might end up costing him his family.

title: Hungry Ghost Festival
overview: After inadvertently violating a sacred ancestral taboo during the Hungry Ghost Festival, an adopted young man and his friends must break a relentless supernatural curse before the spiritual gates close permanently.

title: Anxious People
overview: On the day before Christmas Eve, investment banker Zara begrudgingly finds herself mingling with a group of strangers at an open house. When a reluctant bank robber inadvertently takes the group hostage, chaos and oversharing ensues, secrets are revealed and literally nothing goes according to plan

title: Delusion
overview: The documentary takes Belchior’s famous 1976 album as a starting point to construct a chronicle of 1970s Brazil—a time defined by a generation that sought to change the world but was ultimately cut down by dictatorships or co-opted by money.

title: God Is Still Brazilian
overview: God needs to return to Earth when celestial beings rebel against humanity and decide to launch another meteor to exterminate life on the planet.

title: Дедмобиль
overview: Valera, a flawless driver with 30 years behind the wheel, loses his job just as his dog Lincoln needs an expensive lifesaving surgery. Desperate for income, he’s approached by a sleek, AI-powered self-driving taxi. To avoid spooking passengers, the car asks Valera to pretend to be its driver and help it achieve a top user rating — in exchange for all the earnings from their rides. For Valera, it’s his dog’s only chance; for the taxi, it’s a fight for its own survival.

title: Takluk 2: OP Daulat
overview: An operation that shook the nation starting on February 11, 2013. At that time, Sulu terrorists infiltrated Kampung Tanduo in Lahad Datu, Sabah. By the end of "Op Daulat", 56 terrorists and six civilians were reported killed. The conflict also saw 12 national heroes fall in battle after sacrificing their lives to defend the nation's sovereignty.

title: Path of Titans 4 - DUCK DYNASTY
overview: As a member of the last Deinocheirus family on Gondwa, Duckling is tired of feeling like a complete outcast. Following a lead that could prove there are more out there, she sets out on a transoceanic adventure to prove she's not alone. At the same time, an old threat reemerges to take down the Guardians of Gondwa once and for all, and Duckling's discovery may be exactly what they need.

title: Dona Onete – This Tiny Piece of My Heart
overview: A teacher, activist, and guardian of Amazonian knowledge, Dona Onete became a music star at 72, but her story began much earlier. In this documentary filmed among the rivers and forests of Pará, Onete sings of the banzeiros (drums), the dolphins, and the flavors of the forest with humor and wisdom in a celebration of the living Amazon that pulsates in her voice.

title: Tomorrow a Long Time Ago
overview: Amid German reunification in 1990, 50-year-old Patty first loses her job and then her friend Jelena. In a small East German town, she collects discarded objects and meets the younger Franz. When her flat becomes so full of belongings that she can no longer enter it, she sets out into a colorful forest. A journey through landscapes and history begins—carrying away more than just her.

title: The Anatomy of the Horses
overview: Defeated in combat, Ángel returns home to his village in a remote part of the Peruvian Andes. When he arrives, however, he finds the place has completely changed. What was the 18th century is now the present day. What has become of the ideals of the revolution he fought for? The people who live in Peru today, what are they fighting for?

title: Diya
overview: Dane, a driver for an NGO in N’Djamena (capital of Chad), has the misfortune to run over a schoolboy. His pregnant wife runs to his aid to pay the hospital bills, but it’s too late: the child succumbs to his injuries, and his family summons Dane’s. He will be subjected to the diya, the blood debt, the payment of an exorbitant sum he doesn’t have.

title: Pha Chan
overview: A young couple become entangled in the ritual of "Pha Chan," a practice that severs ties either between living people or between the living and the dead.

title: Prasert
overview: Prasert, the owner of a corrupt rental car business, is chased by top gunmen from all over the country after becoming involved in the murder of the Eastern governor.

title: Father, Son and the Price of Resistance
overview: The father fought against the dictatorship in East Germany using his typewriter. His son took active measures. Two forms of resistance and an abyss of silence. Götz Schauder uses video messages to build a bridge between the two men. A painful struggle for the truth begins.

title: Takshakudu
overview: A blind tribesman and his dog embark on a dangerous quest to face the evil force that burned his village to ashes during one cursed night.

title: Born in The Grave: The Curse of The Village of The Damned
overview: Story of a cursed village. Every three days someone died after experiencing a trance before killing themselves.

title: The Kolotun and the Magic Kingdom
overview: The Snegirev family is preparing to celebrate the New Year together for the last time, after which Anfisa and Igor will tell their son Roma about the divorce.

title: Sumpah Darah
overview: The story goes that Mara was being courted by a mysterious man named Thomas. Thomas’s promise to give her a beautiful, colorful life ended in a horrific, blood-soaked tragedy for the woman.

title: Coquito: La Película
overview: The film, inspired by the life of teacher Everardo Zapata Santillana, will pay tribute to the creator of the emblematic book 'Coquito', which marked millions of schoolchildren inside and outside of Peru.

title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
overview: A heartfelt romantic family drama about two best friends whose close bond slowly turns into love. But one lie creates misunderstandings and conflicts, putting their relationship and family bonds to the test. The story explores love, sacrifice, understanding and the importance of family.

title: Not Waiting for Christmas
overview: Vilius, a popular radio host, is getting ready to celebrate Christmas with his wonderful family. The pleasant anticipation of the holidays is disrupted by unexpected news: his parents, who left him with his grandmother when he was just a little boy and moved to America, are returning to live in Lithuania.

title: Nosebleed
overview: A psycho-sexual queer thriller which blends fantasy and reality against a backdrop of the deep, dark web; told through the eyes of a prospective serial killer.

title: Tears of Neon
overview: At the age of five, Chris, a young village boy meets his mother, Czesława, who is at the cusp of conquering entertainment industry by adopting a new persona — Violetta Villas. An unbelievably talented, ambitious mother and a sensitive child go on a decades long journey through Warsaw, Paris and Las Vegas.

title: Santa Claude
overview: A distinguished lawyer who finds himself having to perform community service after committing a blunder: getting into a shouting match with a mascot during a Christmas parade.

title: OM Chapter 1: Udhiram - The Blood Wood
14th
overview: Revolves around the equal protection and citizenship-focused 14th amendment, which was ratified in 1868 in the turbulent era of Reconstruction and has been a contentious part of the American body politic ever since.

title: Gunmaaster G9
overview: A man in love takes extreme measures to be with the woman he desires, facing off against a dangerous adversary.

title: Forqué. El oficio de hacer cine
overview: Actors and filmmakers revisit the career of José María Forqué, a director whose name is familiar through the awards that honour him but whose work is less widely known. His own voice joins their recollections in a portrait of his approach to filmmaking and his place in Spanish popular cinema.

title: Between Two Lovers
overview: A married woman pursues a simultaneous relationship with a female lover — and proposes that all three live together.

title: A Proud Family Wizmas
overview: A song-filled, stop-motion holiday special

title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Merry Christmas, Mr. Plankton
overview: When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs, and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

title: The Hunchback, Soul of Paris
overview: As the cholera epidemic spreads through the city, Quasimodo is caught between political turmoil and an impossible love.

title: No Me Without You
overview: Two estranged sisters, a fateful tragedy, and a secret that changes everything.

title: Paquet de troubles
overview: Karim, a passionate teenager with a promising future as a musician, learns he has schizophrenia. Devastated by this news, and surrounded by his mother and sister, he tries to rediscover his identity, even putting himself in danger.

title: Mysaa
overview: Unafraid of war and unwilling to stop until she finds that one answer. She carries no doubts. Only the ache of an answer she's searched her whole life.

title: Mailin
overview: While telling her daughter a bedtime story, Mailin pieces her memories back together. What could have been a fairy tale turns out to be the story of a young girl who suffered abuse from a priest for 15 years. It’s a long journey towards healing and justice, but also the chance to offer her daughter the childhood she never had.

title: Ka Kaa Ki Kii

title: Wandance
overview: Kaboku has always just gone with the flow, marching in step to the drumbeat of the expectations of those around him: parents, school, plans for the future. It feels predictable, safe, and… empty. But one night, Kaboku's at school late, and he happens on a girl alone, moving wildly, turning a blank space of concrete into a canvas. This is Hikari Wanda, a member of the hip-hop dance club. Kaboku is immediately smitten, but the road to stepping out of his shell is a long one. The club is almost entirely girls, and they're all, well, way better than him. What's ahead is unknown, and that's terrifying, but it also means, for the first time in Kaboku's life… a taste of freedom.

title: Portrait Of What I Once Saw
overview: An artist who lost her sight in a tragic accident relies on her caregiver’s descriptions to paint the world she can no longer see, but when her companion mysteriously disappears, she must navigate, on her own, a reality built on her fading memories to find what's hiding within the fog.

title: Jumprava: The Big Happening
overview: The epic story of one of the most iconic Latvian rock bands – Jumprava [Yumpravah]. The feature film tells the story about how the electronic rock group Jumprava was founded in 1984 and how it evolved throughout the years until 1991. With their songs and their unique style, Jumprava encouraged the “third awakening” in Latvia and inspired young people to dream big on this side of the Iron Curtain.

title: Your Story
overview: Chihiro, a university student who lives a lonely life, undergoes a treatment to erase his memories in order to forget his unhappy past. However, when he awakens, his memories have not disappeared. Instead, he is left with memories of his first love with Toka, a childhood friend he has never even met. She is supposed to exist only within fabricated memories. Yet before long, Chihiro finds himself unable to get her out of his mind. But one day, Toka appears in the real world.

title: Takopi's Original Sin: Thank You, See You Tomorrow

title: Jindey
overview: The story follows the "mysterious" death and the family of Gurmeet Singh, and tries to explore the grief and the difficult relationship of Gurmeet's Son, Harjas , With his mother, Jaspreet. Jindey is a tale of trauma, love and belongingness.

title: Breve Eternidade
overview: Bárbara and Milena experience the intensity of a magnetic, unspoken connection. Amid moments of contemplation and a latent tension that borders on obsession, the two young women explore the awakening of new feelings while facing the prospect of a departure that could change everything.

title: Mom's Alive Today
overview: Jakov returns to hometown in order to take care of his mother whose suffering from a schizoaffective disorder, however, this intense new element in his life will slowly start to make his own psyche crack.

title: Holiday Ever After: A Disney World Wish Come True
overview: Lindsey and her extended family head to Walt Disney World to spend a magical Christmas together, but the dream of a jolly holiday gets quickly dashed when Lindsey discovers her room is next door to Philip, a disastrous first date she recently had, who’s also there on a family trip. As Lindsey and Philip’s paths cross throughout their stay, the frost starts to thaw as they learn they’re not so different from each other after all. Thanks to some Walt Disney World magic, the holiday wish Lindsey made in Cinderella Fountain just might turn their rivalry into romance.

overview: Jonas, a young magician who has retired from stage, is invited to participate in a film the chaotic production forces him to confront a past trauma, while unexpectedly giving him the chance to overcome it.

title: WWE Survivor Series: WarGames 2026
overview: The 2026 Survivor Series: WarGames, also promoted as Survivor Series: WarGames Houston, is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It will be the 40th annual Survivor Series and will take place on November 28, 2026, at Daikin Park in Houston, Texas. This will be the fifth annual Survivor Series based around the WarGames match, a team-based steel cage match where the roofless cage surrounds two rings placed side by side.

title: Eight Nights for Love
overview: Hannah, who works for a large auction house in New York City, is excited for her best friend Ethan to return home for a visit during Hanukkah and is looking forward to some time off from work That plan is short-lived when Ethan shares the news that he's convinced the daughter of his wealthy boss to use Hannah's auction house to sell their family's collection of Judaica with the condition that Hannah handles the sale. Complicating her holiday further, she meets the mysterious Pearl, who gifts her with an antique menorah that is anything but ordinary as it takes her back to a different times of her life each night of Hanukkah, with Pearl as her guide. This front row seat to past moments leads Hannah to reflect, break out of her comfort zone and overcome her fear of failure. Thanks to her trips through the past, and as she and Ethan spend time together in the present, Hannah realizes she has feelings for him she never acknowledged.

title: Miles to Christmas
overview: When an early snowstorm sweeps through the Midwest, punctual, straight-laced "suit" Cassidy Fields is forced to hitch a ride with free spirited, music loving Johanna "Jo" Woods in her bother Chase's 18-wheeler to the nearest airport to catch another flight. However, when Jo's flight successfully takes off and Cassidy's is cancelled again at the last minute, she joins Chase on the road back to Tennessee from Chicago to make it home in time to spend Christmas with her father. Quickly, Cassidy and Chase's connection begins to spark. Through losing the car keys, stopping to partake in a Mrs. Claus parade and a surprise run-in with Jo, whose plane got grounded mid-flight due to weather, Cassidy builds bonds with both siblings as they all challenge one another's life philosophies. As the trio pushes past every obstacle, they work to embrace their differences and find that the fastest way home is when they lean on one another for help.

title: The Defectors
overview: In a near-future surveillance state, a detective secretly aligned with a rebellion investigates the assassination of their leader under the watchful eye of his manipulative new partner.

title: The Afterlife of Cinema
overview: 2030. After the latest technological revolution driven by artificial intelligence, cinema has been declared extinct and films are considered obsolete. When Margot, an unemployed film critic, discovers a poster for a clandestine film festival, she embarks on a journey that challenges everything she believes about memory, cinema, and what it means for a film to survive.

title: Behind Closed Doors
overview: Marie, a young doctor, experienced a miscarriage four months ago. Unable to grieve, the marriage to her French husband Jude starts to break apart. But when her parents pay them an unexpected visit, the world which Marie has built for herself so carefully starts to crumble.

title: The Wonderful Wizard Of Ha's
overview: When a cosmic warp strikes a commuter tracks, a stylish teenager named Dorthy Ross ( Soroya Clayton-Wright) and her trusty dog poodle Smarty  are transported from the ordinary world straight into Stardust City—a glittering, neon-lit fantasy metropolis. Arriving in style aboard a custom-built, purple clockwork locomotive, she is greeted by the glamorous The Good Witch of the South ( Joh'Vonnie Monroe ), who welcomes her with a show-stopping musical number.  But the party is short-lived. Armed with a pink shirt, a purple poodle skirt, and a magical pair of silver slippers, the young trendsetter must navigate the dangers of the Yellow Brick Road after the Wicked Witch crashes the celebration. Packed with high-fashion aesthetics, explosive blue-diamond wand fireworks, and a soulful, show-stopping soundtrack, The Wonderful Wizard of Ha's is a bold, comedic, and modern reimagining of L. Frank Baum’s classic 1900 tale.

title: Fear Addiction
overview: "Once it gets into your head, it never leaves."  A woman tormented by various phobias, including trypophobia, is gradually consumed by madness following an encounter with a mysterious figure.
